subject: Request for Amendment to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

Several discrepancies were found that require your attention.

The Consignee is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but reads UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft Bill of Lading.

Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but reads UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft Bill of Lading.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
